# Maxzz Diesel

> Wholesale supplier of diesel fuel injection parts: common rail injectors, high-pressure pumps, nozzles, control valves, repair kits, Robiel tool sets, ISO 4113 calibration fluid and SCR / NOx aftertreatment test equipment. Founded in 1992. 6601 Lyons Road, Ste H-6, Coconut Creek, FL 33073, USA. Phone +1 (954) 586-4158, sales@maxzzdiesel.com. Sells to rebuilders, injection labs, distributors, repair shops and fleets in North America and Latin America, in English, Spanish and Portuguese. In-stock orders placed by 3 pm Eastern ship the same day. Prices by quote or through the wholesale login.

## Key facts
- Brands: Bosch, Delphi, Denso, Continental, Cummins, LEAD, Fratelli Bosio, Robiel, SLP
- Engines: Cummins 5.9/6.7, ISX15, XPI; Duramax 6.6 LB7 to L5P; Power Stroke 6.0/6.4/6.7; Detroit DD15, Series 60; Caterpillar C7 to C15; Volvo D13; Paccar MX13
- Calibration fluid: ISO 4113, 20 L pails and 200 L drums
- Aftertreatment: Maxzz Aftertreatment Box (SCR / DEF pump bench, 11 pump systems) and NOx Tester Box (Euro 5 and Euro 6)
- Contamination kits: Ford 6.7L Power Stroke 2017-2019, Cummins 6.7L 5th Gen
